testSent: Test message sent ({latency} ms). Check the group to confirm.
title: Notifications
subtitle: Push findings to DingTalk / Feishu / WeCom and other channels · each channel sets its own timing and filter rules
baseUrlHint: The address the "View details" button in messages points to. Leave blank to omit the button.
digestHint: Only applies to channels in "Digest" mode.
kindLocked: The channel type can't be changed. Changing it would mean a different set of credentials, so create a new channel instead.
namePlaceholder: Incident response group / daily briefing group
noFields: The form for this channel isn't defined yet (missing CHANNEL_FIELDS entry in the frontend). Complete it and try again.
modeDigest: Digest · merged into one message per interval
modeHint: To get "high severity in realtime, everything else in a digest", create two channels: one realtime with a high-severity threshold, and one digest with no severity limit.
rateHint: Leave blank to use the channel default; 0 means unlimited. Messages are never dropped when the limit is hit; they are only delayed.
includeLabel: Only notify for these vulnerability types
includeHint: One keyword per line, case-insensitive substring match. Blank = all types.
excludeHint: Exclusions take precedence: a finding matching both is excluded.
assetsHint: Blank task/asset = no limit; when set, a finding must intersect them.
statusChange: Also notify when a finding's handling status changes (realtime mode only)
